104,598,162 bytes differ: zlib-rs (larmorx) and zlib-ng 2.1.6 (ITK's HDF5) choose other matches, so the compressed chunks, their sizes and the addresses after them differ; the content does not

tables.note: larmorx writes the transforms it read from fMRIPrep's file (`lx.transforms.write`). ITK's own file is the one antsApplyTransforms wrote above; `itk_h5_replay` rewrites it with larmorx's writer, ITK's strings and times and, first, ITK's compressed chunks.
